field.label: Reporter enabled
field.help: Submit local firewall block events to AbuseIPDB. Requires a rule label to mark reportable events.

field.label: Dry-run (don't actually submit)
field.help: When enabled, candidates are logged to the Log tab as 'would send' but no POST /report call is made. Recommended for 24h before going live, to verify that the selected hits are legitimate attack traffic.

field.label: Pre-check IP against AbuseIPDB
field.help: Before reporting, look the IP up via /api/v2/check and skip it if AbuseIPDB has no confidence score (nobody else has reported it). Dramatically reduces false positives on one-off scanners. Costs one API call per candidate.

field.label: Pre-check minimum confidence
field.help: Only report if AbuseIPDB already shows at least this confidence score (0-100). 0 = report if IP is present at all; 25 = already considered suspicious by others; 50+ = only known-bad. Default 25.

field.label: Minimum hits before report
field.help: Number of block events from an IP before it is reported. Reduces false positives.

field.label: Rate limit per IP (min)
field.help: Minimum minutes between two reports for the same IP.

field.label: Daily report quota
field.help: Maximum number of reports submitted per day. Free-tier allows 1000.

field.label: Default categories
field.help: Comma-separated AbuseIPDB category IDs used when a rule has no specific mapping. 14=PortScan, 15=Hacking, 18=BruteForce, 22=SSH.
